scorecard.notes: Evaluated on 30,000 pure benign flows from Thursday-01-03 (15,000) and Friday-23-02 (15,000). Produced exactly 6 false alarms (3 MONITOR, 3 BLOCK).

scorecard.criterion: Benign FPR 95% Wilson Score Interval & Upper Bound
scorecard.inconsistency_resolution: The previous Phase 7 report displayed both [0.0092%, 0.0435%] and 0.0400%. The raw unrounded standard 95% Wilson upper bound is 0.0436% (0.0459% with continuity correction). The 0.0400% figure originated from truncating the rounded array output [0.0001, 0.0004]. Under all definitions, the upper bound is strictly < 0.1000%.

reconciliation_of_reported_N_38566.explanation: The reported N=38,566 represents the sum of all 8,566 evaluated attack flows plus the 30,000 large-scale benign flows. The remaining 5,000 rows on disk are the 1,000 baseline benign flows embedded in each of the 5 attack parquets for per-slice control testing.

benign_row_overlap_audit.explanation: Due to deterministic random seeding (random_state=42), the 1,000 benign flows sampled for holdout_web_attacks.parquet and 974 of the 1,000 benign flows sampled for holdout_infiltration.parquet overlap with the 15,000 benign flows sampled from the same source CSVs in holdout_benign_30k.parquet. Consequently, pooling benign flows across parquets would double-count records. The evaluation harness correctly evaluated each file independently.
